reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
Updated review 10/31/26: I found your reply to my review condescending, as if I did not know that it doesn’t permanently watermark my photos or know that I had to pay now to remove it. That was not the issues, it was that your app became unusable with your watermark, without warning or options. Thankfully, I found another photo widget app that was $9.99 for life rather than $12/month. You have lost this user. 

I’ve been using this app for years and it’s been great, EXCEPT now suddenly there’s a watermark and a fee to remove it. I can understand charging more for new features, but to make the app that I already have *worse* by adding the watermark and now having to pay to remove it is frustrating.

reviews.title: WAS a good app
reviews.text: You guys are ridiculous if you think I’m gonna pay $12 so I don’t have to see a watermark in the corner of my pictures. I was OK with the ads after every single thing I did on your app because I was never on it. There are better deals, better apps, and overall a better experience I can get somewhere else. I’m not gonna hesitate deleting everything and moving on and I hope other people don’t hesitate to not give in to companies putting everything behind a paywall. Also thanks for the response but it helped nothing. The photos did change cause of the watermark I have to pay to get rid of.

reviews.title: Was good until deceitful paid updates
reviews.text:
Had for years, used to always have photos of my deceased cat on my Home Screen. Recently had a text banner overlaid on the image, so I click to try and disable… and am prompted to subscribe. Two qualms:
-The “Most Popular” option is 3 days free, then $4/week… or $208/year. Right below it is $25/year. Misleading with the highlighted top option and hoping folks just click it cause it’s the most popular.
-Below both options is “Continue for Free”… I’ve been using the app for free for years, so I click that. And it prompts me to start paying for the $4/week version.

Great app up until this misleading and predatory attempt.
